shots.camera: Wide vertical establishing shot, slow gentle push-in, eye level
shots.action: Ayesha walks naturally across the living room past the sofa and curtains towards the kitchen doorway, soft daylight through the window

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.urdu: آج عائشہ اپنی ماما سے ایک بہت پیاری عادت سیکھنے والی ہے۔
dialogue.roman: Aaj Ayesha apni Mama se aik bohat pyari aadat seekhne wali hai.

shots.sfx: Soft footsteps on tiled floor, distant birds, ceiling fan hum

shots.camera: Vertical medium shot from the kitchen doorway
shots.action: Mother stands at the stove stirring a pot of daal, then turns to chop fresh vegetables on a cutting board
shots.sfx: Gentle simmering, knife chopping on wooden board

shots.camera: Vertical medium two-shot
shots.action: Ayesha steps into the kitchen and greets her mother; mother looks up and smiles warmly

shots.camera: Natural vertical medium close-up on Ayesha, mother partly in frame
shots.action: Ayesha stands beside her mother at the counter, looks up at her and asks a question

dialogue.speaker: ayesha
dialogue.urdu: ماما، کھانا کھانے سے پہلے کیا پڑھنا چاہیے؟
dialogue.roman: Mama, khana khanay se pehle kya parhna chahiye?

shots.camera: Natural vertical medium close-up on mother, over Ayesha's shoulder
shots.action: Mother pauses her cooking, smiles and looks gently down at Ayesha while answering

dialogue.speaker: mother
dialogue.urdu: بیٹا، کھانا شروع کرنے سے پہلے بسم اللہ پڑھتے ہیں۔
dialogue.roman: Beta, khana shuru karne se pehle Bismillah parhte hain.

shots.camera: Vertical close-up on mother's face, shallow depth of field
shots.action: Mother bends slightly to Ayesha's eye level and speaks slowly and clearly

shots.camera: Vertical close-up on Ayesha's face
shots.action: Ayesha repeats the word carefully, then smiles shyly

shots.camera: Vertical close two-shot, faces side by side
shots.action: Mother praises Ayesha and gently touches her shoulder; Ayesha nods happily, understanding

dialogue.speaker: mother
dialogue.urdu: شاباش بیٹا! اس کا مطلب ہے: اللہ کے نام سے۔
dialogue.roman: Shabash beta! Iska matlab hai: Allah ke naam se.

shots.camera: Vertical medium-wide shot of the dining table
shots.action: Mother places a bowl of homemade daal and a vegetable curry on the wooden table; Ayesha sets down a basket of fresh roti; salad and a water jug already on the table
shots.sfx: Plates and bowls placed gently on wood

shots.camera: Vertical medium two-shot beside the table
shots.action: Mother reminds Ayesha to wash her hands; Ayesha answers cheerfully and turns towards the sink

dialogue.speaker: mother
dialogue.urdu: بیٹا، کھانے سے پہلے اپنے ہاتھ دھونا ضروری ہے۔
dialogue.roman: Beta, khanay se pehle apne haath dhona zaroori hai.

shots.camera: Vertical medium shot at the sink, then close-up on hands
shots.action: Ayesha rolls back her sleeves slightly, washes her hands with soap and water, dries them on a towel and walks back to the dining table
shots.sfx: Running tap water, soap lather, towel rustle, footsteps

shots.camera: Vertical medium shot
shots.action: Mother and Ayesha pull out their chairs and sit down comfortably facing the food

shots.camera: Vertical medium close-up on mother, then insert on her right hand near her plate
shots.action: Mother raises her right hand and points to the food directly in front of her plate while explaining

dialogue.speaker: mother
dialogue.urdu: ہمیشہ دائیں ہاتھ سے کھاؤ، اور اپنے سامنے سے کھاؤ۔
dialogue.roman: Hamesha daayen haath se khao, aur apne saamne se khao.

shots.camera: Vertical medium close-up on Ayesha
shots.action: Ayesha nods and raises her right hand slightly to show she understands

dialogue.speaker: ayesha
dialogue.urdu: ٹھیک ہے ماما، میں یاد رکھوں گی!
dialogue.roman: Theek hai Mama, main yaad rakhoon gi!

shots.camera: Vertical close-up, slow push-in on Ayesha's face
shots.action: Ayesha tears a small piece of roti with her right hand, lifts it, then pauses before her first bite
shots.sfx: Soft roti tear, quiet room tone

shots.camera: Vertical close-up on Ayesha
shots.action: Ayesha's face brightens as she remembers and softly says Bismillah

shots.camera: Vertical medium two-shot across the table
shots.action: Mother's face lights up with pride; Ayesha begins eating the roti and daal with her right hand
shots.expression: Surprised expression turning into natural happiness

shots.camera: Vertical medium close-up on Ayesha
shots.action: Ayesha looks at her mother with a proud happy smile and makes a promise

dialogue.speaker: ayesha
dialogue.urdu: ماما، اب میں ہمیشہ بسم اللہ پڑھ کر کھانا شروع کروں گی!
dialogue.roman: Mama, ab main hamesha Bismillah parh kar khana shuru karoon gi!

shots.camera: Vertical medium two-shot, mother and daughter smiling at each other
shots.action: Mother gently strokes Ayesha's hijab-covered head and smiles lovingly; they smile at each other

dialogue.speaker: mother
dialogue.urdu: ماشاءاللہ بیٹا! اپنی روزمرہ زندگی میں ہمیشہ اللہ کو یاد رکھنا۔
dialogue.roman: MashaAllah beta! Apni rozmarra zindagi mein hamesha Allah ko yaad rakhna.

shots.camera: Slow vertical pull-back to a wide shot of the family table in warm daylight
shots.action: Mother and Ayesha continue eating together peacefully

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.urdu: ہمیشہ اپنا کھانا اللہ کے نام سے شروع کریں۔
dialogue.roman: Hamesha apna khana Allah ke naam se shuru karein.

shots.overlay: کھانے سے پہلے اللہ کو یاد کریں!

shots.camera: Hold on the blurred last frame
shots.action: End card: blurred final frame with title text overlay
shots.overlay:
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ
کھانے سے پہلے اللہ کو یاد کریں!
